chapter: The 1949 band, breakup and later years
title: Martha Raye's jealous husband, Alaska and Palm Beach
summary: After leaving Raye he led a small band to Anchorage, Florida and the Bahamas, where a Palm Beach society woman propositioned him.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: I wasn't you know, but he was very jealous and drunk all the time, and he thought something was going on, and what was going on was she'd had it with him and he was looking to blame anybody he could blame. So I got out of that scene. And I had this little band I put together, with Buddy Childress, like I told you. We came back and we played the El Rancho and some other places, and we went up to Alaska. We were up there for two weeks, up in Anchorage. And if I'd have stayed up there another week I think I'd have come home in a box, because we went up there to entertain -- we were playing on the base, the Elmendorf Air Force Base, and they figured that they had to entertain us. So like very night, it was just terrible. I was a physical wreck when I got home from there. Then I played around some more clubs around L.A., and we went to -- back to Florida. We played the Dream Lounge with this band there, Buddy Childress again, and then we went over in the Bahamas. We played over there, in Nassau. Then we came back and we played Palm Beach, at a place there. And oh, that was -- it was society belles. Something else. One of them dragged me out at intermission, got me out on the beach, and she wanted to -- like, "Let's make it right now, baby." I said, "You've got to be kidding." She said, "No. My husband is drunk. Why don't you come over to the house later and we'll --," I said, "Hold the phone. None of that stuff, you know." So we came home from there, and let's see, Arnold Ross
